title: Anthropic Cuts Claude Fable 5.1 Pricing for Agentic Work
dek: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.1 improves performance while lowering typical costs by about 25%, with savings of up to 45% on complex agentic workflows that reuse cached context.
socialCaption: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.1 is about 25% cheaper in typical use and up to 45% cheaper for complex agentic tasks, largely through lower cached-context pricing. For AI builders, the real test is cost per completed workflow—not token price alone.
